exposure: facility where cesarean section (CS) was performed
Facility where cesarean section was performed
cohort: 421 mothers who gave birth by cesarean section
finding: Counseling during antenatal care, the facility where the cesarean section was performed, and post-cesarean section counseling were positively associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding among mothers who delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study focused on identifying factors associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding specifically among mothers who had a cesarean section delivery.
